note: An Ochorus Original whose English quotes the King James Version; every displayed quotation in this Portuguese edition is the Bíblia Livre para o Mundo (por_bpm, public domain), pasted byte-for-byte by script from the ebible mirror. A row is `mined` only where the finished block was re-measured to contain a contiguous span of the verse (at least 25 characters, or the whole of a shorter verse); prayer adaptations, re-personed echoes and paraphrases are self_rendered. Bare citations that quote no words are not listed.

Where the Bíblia Livre differs from the KJV word the English argues from, the verse is kept verbatim and the next sentence adjusted lightly: Luke 9:23 (no 'daily'; ch. 8, 9), 1 Thessalonians 5:23 ('completamente' for 'wholly'; ch. 9), Psalm 4:1 (no 'enlarged'; ch. 11), 2 Peter 3:12 ('desejando ardentemente' for 'hasting unto'; ch. 18).
AI-translated (job #7634) in six parallel ranges against one conventions file, then reconciled. Awaiting native review.
